scope.review: Repository-wide syntax and Ruff checks; manual numerical/data-flow review concentrated on measurement, plotting, attention/normalization, checkpoint loading, training/evaluation and report aggregation.
not_executed: Full historical training runs and all pretrained model/task configurations
Optional archived Triton kernel (dispatch behavior tested using SDPA emulation)
Generated historical source snapshots under ignored results/evidence archives

findings.problem: Repeated embeddings[0] in the batch loop assigned the first sample spectral norm to other samples. Exact SVD now uses each sample and excludes padding.
findings.resolution: All eight plotted models remeasured; 12248 MMLU rows; actual batch 1/4 comparisons recorded in mmlu_remeasurement.json.

findings.problem: 259 nonfinite first-layer norms were stored in the unplotted random-data column; original random inputs were not retained.
findings.resolution: All eight plotted models remeasured; seed and actual token IDs retained; exact SVD; all columns finite.

findings.problem: Six models in the V spectral panel mistakenly used Q; large-model norms were handwritten.
findings.resolution: 11 models and 33 matrices remeasured from pinned weights; notebook reads measured JSON.

findings.problem: Hidden width was labeled as a square matrix dimension although GQA K/V matrices are rectangular.
findings.resolution: Figure labels hidden width d; JSON records every actual matrix shape.

findings.problem: Linear [out,in] and GPT Conv1D [in,out] storage directions were mixed in column statistics; reductions used float16.
findings.resolution: Canonical S @ W layout, float64 reductions, pooled sample variance; all seven paper models plus five other model variants remeasured.

findings.problem: Loading bart-base with AutoModelForCausalLM left its shared embedding table randomly initialized in the tested version. Legacy BART arrays also used inconsistent undocumented schemas.
findings.resolution: Load native BartModel encoder; checked shared.weight against safetensors; new MMLU/random encoder arrays use four columns and separate provenance.

findings.problem: Interleaved frequencies were incompatible with split-half rotation and did not preserve norms.
findings.resolution: Match frequencies to split-half coordinates; rebuild old cached buffers on checkpoint load; norm and relative-position regression tests.

findings.problem: RoPE path omitted out_proj and discarded attn_mask when padding was supplied; public batch_first, bias=False, kdim/vdim and attention-weight behavior were inconsistent.
findings.resolution: Unified implementation with explicit layouts, combined masks and output projection; compared numerically against PyTorch MHA across 36 configurations.

findings.problem: Half-precision reductions could overflow, and zero padding could produce 0/0 in embedding normalization.
findings.resolution: At least float32 reduction for half weights; zero-safe initialization; preserve output dtype.

findings.problem: Native float16 cap reduction produced NaN gradients at zero because epsilon underflowed.
findings.resolution: Compute epsilon/division in float32 even when using native reductions; finite-gradient regression test.

findings.problem: Two power iterations underestimate the norm and can return zero when the initial all-ones vector lies in the nullspace; the claimed projection then fails.
findings.resolution: SN projection uses exact matrix spectral norm; adversarial matrix test; nonfinite norms rejected. This is slower than the old approximation.

findings.problem: The saved in-memory best state aliased live model parameters and was overwritten during later optimization. Restoration was also conditional on early stopping.
findings.resolution: Deep-copy the selected state and restore it before final testing, with or without early stopping.

findings.problem: Test data was passed to Trainer for checkpoint selection despite a separate dev split.
findings.resolution: Use dev for model selection and test only for final evaluation.

findings.problem: Legacy comparison variants shared the same trainable embedding module, so sequential training altered later variants.
findings.resolution: Each of six single-layer training/fine-tuning recipes deep-copies the starting embeddings per variant.

findings.problem: Loading vanilla weights with strict=False silently skipped parametrized weights; DNABERT normalized fine-tuning variants were initialized randomly while their baseline was pretrained.
findings.resolution: Explicit mapping of weights and fused QKV; reject missing pretrained parameters; only newly introduced norm controls may remain initialized. Both DNABERT variants load the baseline backbone/head.

findings.problem: Attention-only/FFN-only flags in two scripts selected the wrong settings; Genomic Benchmarks used the repository model ID as a shared checkpoint prefix.
findings.resolution: Correct flags, and save with per-variant labels.

findings.problem: Evaluation averaged batch means equally, over-weighting a partial final batch.
findings.resolution: Weight losses by batch sample counts in both GLUE evaluators; batch-partition invariance test.

findings.problem: The second RMS denominator was omitted from resource aggregation; hidden_growth required a spectral column it did not check.
findings.resolution: Include rms2_denom and validate required columns; regression tests.

findings.problem: A singleton tuple of model logits retained an extra dimension.
findings.resolution: Unwrap model output tuples consistently; binary classification regression test.

findings.problem: The optional flash path used native scaling even when the normalized PyTorch path used the configured alternative scaling.
findings.resolution: Pass the same explicit scale; dispatch tested against SDPA emulation. Optional Triton kernel itself was not executed.

retained_findings: Ruff F821 reports on closures whose captured variables are deleted only after hooks/callbacks have finished: inspected, not undefined at call time.
Lazy PrintMetricsCallback export is resolved by __getattr__.
Loop callbacks flagged B023 are invoked synchronously before iteration advances.
Global NumPy seeding/get_state/set_state are intentional for legacy/vendor reproducibility.
Existing unused imports and style-only warnings were not bulk-reformatted.

historical_results.required_followup: Retrain/evaluate affected legacy experiments before attributing reported accuracies to the corrected implementation. Old checkpoints retain old learned weights even though deterministic RoPE caches are repaired on load.
